findings.detail: The Scrut live-forwarding condition appears in both the inclusion filter and kind selection. Naming it once makes the negated pipeline expression easier to follow and keeps both decisions visibly aligned.
findings.fix: Bind ($scrut and $dest == "stdout") as $live_forward, then reuse it in both expressions while preserving the $closes override.
findings.title: write-bash-scripts: Naming: Name the live-forwarding condition once.

findings.detail: The new exception comment repeats the immediately preceding test heading. Similar annotations throughout the changed Scrut documents add substantial repeated text without further explaining why diagnostic capture is allowed.
findings.fix: Keep the required marker with a concise reason such as '# error-output-allow: snapshot asserts merged stderr', omitting the copied heading where redundant.
findings.title: write-scrut-tests: Explained tests: Avoid repeating headings in exception reasons.

strengths: Source extraction, parsing and policy validation have distinct responsibilities.
Static samples make individual acceptance and rejection cases easy to trace.
summary: Reviewed the complete committed scope and found two optional clarity improvements. No files were changed, and no mechanical checks or repository scripts were run.
